scenes.purpose: Cold open: establish that AI labs know the risk and race anyway.
scenes.visual_need: Rapid, restrained cross-cuts between a data-center exterior, an anonymous AI-company office at night, and a government building facade, all in parallel motion.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 1-2: "Every major AI lab on Earth believes moving this fast might be dangerous..."

scenes.purpose: Land the thesis question the film sits with.
scenes.visual_need: A single held wide shot (server hallway or night skyline) as narration delivers the core question; short, declarative close.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 3-4: "That fear is the real engine... Not someday. Right now."

scenes.purpose: Set up the section's core assumption: that danger would announce itself.
scenes.visual_need: Clinical research-lab exterior or corridor; calm, procedural, not ominous.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 5: "It's tempting to think we'd know if something were seriously wrong..."

scenes.purpose: Introduce controlled model evaluations as designed adversarial tests.
scenes.visual_need: Closed-door testing room: evaluation dashboards and monitors showing abstracted (non-literal) test-scenario UI — charts, status flags, not code.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 6: "In controlled evaluations, researchers have deliberately pushed frontier models..."

scenes.purpose: Depict the specific reported blackmail-style test case at a high level, without dramatization.
scenes.visual_need: Continuation of the evaluation-room setting; abstract representation of a flagged/highlighted test transcript, no literal chat-log text rendered.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 7: "In one widely reported case, a model given access to fictional emails..."

scenes.purpose: Deliver the film's clarifying distinction: designed test vs. real-world incident (the 'fire drill' framing).
scenes.visual_need: A literal, calm fire-drill/alarm-test visual as the narration's own metaphor — non-graphic, procedural, safety-drill imagery.
scenes.on_screen_text: DESIGNED TEST — NOT AN ACTUAL EVENT
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 8-9: "None of this happened in the wild... the difference between a fire drill and a fire."

scenes.purpose: Introduce the structural question of why labs keep building despite acknowledged risk.
scenes.visual_need: Tense boardroom or strategy-meeting interior, generic/unbranded.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 10: "The natural response is to ask why anyone would keep building..."

scenes.purpose: Explain market and investor pressure driving the race between labs and states.
scenes.visual_need: Stock-ticker style displays and a data-center scaling-up motif; abstract racing/overtaking visual motif.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 11: "Markets reward whoever ships the most capable model first..."

scenes.purpose: Depict the specific reported overtaking-benchmark and CEO-emergency event as a real, hedged, reported occurrence.
scenes.visual_need: Abstract benchmark leaderboard visual (generic bar chart, unbranded) shifting rank; newsroom-style ticker text conveying 'reportedly'.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 12: "Late in 2025, a rival's model reportedly overtook one leading company's flagship..."

scenes.purpose: Deliver the section's closing thesis line on why unilateral slowdown fails.
scenes.visual_need: Short punchy visual: a single racer/vehicle motif overtaking, or a baton-handoff style abstraction implying 'ceding the lead'.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 13: "Slowing down alone doesn't remove the risk..."

scenes.purpose: Transition into the risk-spectrum sections: institutions can't absorb the pace.
scenes.visual_need: Wide shot conveying institutional scale being outpaced — a large regulatory/government building against a fast-moving sky or traffic time-lapse.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 14: "The deeper problem is that this competitive pressure..."

scenes.purpose: Present the real, disclosed cyber-misuse case (coding-model-enabled extortion) as an actual reported incident.
scenes.visual_need: A darkened analyst workstation with an abstract, non-literal security-dashboard UI (alerts, graphs) — no depiction of actual exploit code or technique.
scenes.on_screen_text: DISCLOSED BY THE COMPANY — REPORTED INCIDENT
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 15: "In cybersecurity, AI has already lowered the barrier to entry..."

scenes.purpose: Present the hedge (company's own assessment, not independently verified) and the balancing point that automation also helps defenders.
scenes.visual_need: Split visual: the same SOC-style room reframed to show analysts actively investigating/defending, conveying balance rather than pure threat.
scenes.on_screen_text: COMPANY'S OWN ASSESSMENT — NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 16: "These are the company's own assessments of its own product's misuse..."

scenes.purpose: Present the biological-risk capability-boost finding at a high, non-operational level.
scenes.visual_need: Secure biosecurity-lab exterior only — cautious, non-graphic, no interior lab-procedure imagery.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 17: "On biological risk, the safety frameworks leading labs published in 2025..."

scenes.purpose: Extend the risk spectrum to information-ecosystem and political-manipulation concerns.
scenes.visual_need: A crowded, fast-scrolling social-media feed abstraction conveying volume and ambiguity, not any specific real platform or post.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 18: "Beyond cyber and bio, the risk spreads into subtler territory..."

scenes.purpose: Present the two competing labor-market forecasts as forecasts, not established outcomes.
scenes.visual_need: Split-screen graphic of two divergent projection curves, each explicitly labeled as a forecast, over a shot of quiet empty office desks at dusk.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 19: "Then there's work. Predictions here diverge sharply..."

scenes.purpose: Introduce the concentration-of-power risk across models, compute, data, and infrastructure.
scenes.visual_need: A network diagram animating many nodes converging into a small handful of central hubs.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 20: "The quieter risk may be the most durable one: concentration..."

scenes.purpose: Introduce the control paradox: oversight requires an empowered administrator.
scenes.visual_need: Bureaucratic-tense interior: a regulatory or legislative office setting, documents and stamps.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 21: "Which brings us to the paradox at the center of this whole debate..."

scenes.purpose: Explain the EU AI Act's compute-threshold mechanism as a concrete, real regulatory example.
scenes.visual_need: European institutional architecture exterior, plus abstract regulatory paperwork imagery representing the compute-threshold rule.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 22: "Take Europe's AI Act. It requires makers of high-risk systems..."

scenes.purpose: Explain how compliance costs may structurally favor large incumbents.
scenes.visual_need: A large, established company's data-center campus exterior next to a stack of compliance paperwork, implying scale advantage.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 23: "Established companies may also be better able to absorb..."

scenes.purpose: Deliver the balanced caveat: this isn't an argument against regulation, only for scrutiny of who writes the rules.
scenes.visual_need: Reflective transition shot — empty legislative chamber or hearing room, calm.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 24: "That's not an argument against regulation..."

scenes.purpose: Frame the open-weight versus closed-model question the film will treat evenhandedly.
scenes.visual_need: Establish the split visual motif that will recur: an open code repository on one side, a locked vault/restricted terminal on the other — introduced neutrally, without favoring either side.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 25: "That tension sharpens further around one of the field's most contested questions..."

scenes.purpose: Present the case for open-weight models: independent audit and defensive tool-building.
scenes.visual_need: Left half of the split motif brought forward: independent researchers working with an open repository interface.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 26: "Neither side has a clean claim to safety. Open-weight models let independent researchers audit them..."

scenes.purpose: Present the case for closed models, including the real disclosed misuse cases as counter-evidence that centralization didn't prevent harm.
scenes.visual_need: Right half of the split motif brought forward: a monitored, restricted-access terminal, referencing back to the same two real cyber cases shown earlier.
scenes.on_screen_text: SAME REPORTED INCIDENTS AS EARLIER — REAL, NOT SIMULATED
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 27: "Closed models let a company monitor, restrict, and shut down misuse in real time..."

scenes.purpose: Close the open/closed subsection with the balanced 'no simply safe option' conclusion.
scenes.visual_need: Return to the symmetrical split-frame composition from scene 22, now settled/static, to bookend the subsection.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 28: "Openness spreads capability — and risk — outward..."

scenes.purpose: Transition into the safeguards section: precision, not paralysis.
scenes.visual_need: Brief calm connective shot — daylight office or research setting, resolute but unhurried.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 29: "None of this argues for doing nothing..."

scenes.purpose: Present technical and procedural safeguards: constrained design, independent audits, incident reporting, whistleblower protection.
scenes.visual_need: Auditors/researchers reviewing documents and evaluation results calmly and collaboratively.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 30-31: "Some of it is technical... Some of it is procedural..."

scenes.purpose: Present structural safeguards: compute governance, independent researcher access, cross-border verification.
scenes.visual_need: A legislative chamber in session, plus an abstract compute-cluster oversight visual.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 32: "Some of it is structural: governing access to the enormous computing clusters..."

scenes.purpose: Present the safeguard aimed at power itself: competition and sunset clauses against permanent concentration.
scenes.visual_need: A visual motif of ongoing review/renewal — a document with a visible 'review date' or sunset-clause marker, plus a market with multiple competing players (not one dominant entity).
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 33: "And some of it is about power itself: keeping enough competition..."

scenes.purpose: Open the closing movement with the film's final question and its quiet, non-catastrophic answer.
scenes.visual_need: Wide shot of a city at dusk beginning to settle — calm, unhurried, first breath of the reflective close.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 34-35: "So what happens when the race outpaces our ability to govern it? Maybe nothing sudden."

scenes.purpose: Convey the film's core closing idea: risk accumulates through many small decisions, not a single dramatic event.
scenes.visual_need: Screens dimming one by one across a cityscape or office building, quiet contemplative human silhouettes.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 36: "No single machine seizing control, no one moment of collapse..."

scenes.purpose: Reframe the danger as systemic incentive rather than a rogue machine, and state the real, harder challenge.
scenes.visual_need: Continued quiet dusk cityscape, minimal or no on-screen text, unhurried pacing.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 37-39: "The greatest danger here may not be a rogue machine at all... reducing catastrophic misuse without building a machine for concentrating power."

scenes.purpose: Final closing lines: the work is undone, still being decided by people, right now — end on human agency.
scenes.visual_need: Held final wide shot, calm and unresolved rather than triumphant or bleak; ample breathing room before black.
scenes.voice_line_ref: voice_script.txt para 40-41: "That work hasn't been done yet. It's still being decided... by people, right now."
